How auto-sorting works
  • Phone: flagged Invalid if it's empty, too short, or not a real-looking number — otherwise Valid.
  • Link sorting: the scraper's "website" field gets checked — facebook.com → Facebook, instagram.com → Instagram, tiktok.com → TikTok, anything else → general Link field.
  • Location: the Google Maps place URL is stored separately as the lead's map location.
  • Email: imported as-is if the scraper found one (rare from Maps scrapes — you'll likely fill these in yourself after research).
